title: Helios Console — Branding & UX
description: Managed configuration for Helios Console branding and user-experience settings. Preference domain MUST be com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.ui — deploy via Jamf Pro > Configuration Profiles > Application & Custom Settings (External Applications / Custom Schema) scoped to ALL managed Macs running Helios. This domain carries NO secrets and no destructive capability; it is safe to scope broadly. Values are FORCED and take effect at the next app relaunch. NOTE: sidebarItems and authentication are both ENFORCED in views — see docs/ConfigProfileMigration.md for the per-key enforcement-status table.

configurationVersion.title: Configuration Version
configurationVersion.description: Schema/profile version stamp (informational — the loader logs it, nothing else reads it).

userInterface.title: User Interface
userInterface.description: Branding and top-level UI visibility switches.

appTitle.title: App Title
appTitle.description: Primary app title shown in branding surfaces.

appSubtitle.title: App Subtitle
appSubtitle.description: Secondary title shown under the app title.

supportURL.title: Support URL
supportURL.description: Help/support link surfaced in the app (e.g. on the login screen). Leave empty to hide. e.g. https://support.yourcompany.com

companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: Organization name used in branding surfaces. Leave empty for none.

logoURL.title: Logo URL
logoURL.description: HTTPS URL to a custom organization logo image. Leave empty to use the built-in branding.

accentColor.title: Accent Color (hex)
accentColor.description: Accent color as a 6-digit hex value, e.g. #007AFF.

defaultColorScheme.title: Default Color Scheme
defaultColorScheme.description: Preferred appearance for the app. 'system' follows the macOS appearance.

showEnrollments.title: Show Enrollments
showEnrollments.description: Show the Enrollments area in the app.

showAnnouncements.title: Show Announcements
showAnnouncements.description: Show the Announcements area in the app.

showSettings.title: Show Settings
showSettings.description: Show the Settings area in the app.

tagline.title: Tagline
tagline.description: Marketing tagline under the wordmark on the welcome screen. Empty = built-in copy.

footerText.title: Footer Text
footerText.description: Footer/copyright line on the Settings About card. Empty = composed from the product name and current year.

documentationURL.title: Documentation URL
documentationURL.description: Destination for the About card's Documentation link and the welcome screen's Learn More button. Empty = those affordances are hidden.

feedbackURL.title: Feedback URL
feedbackURL.description: Destination for the About card's Report an Issue link. Empty = the row is hidden.

sidebarItems.title: Sidebar Items (optional override)
sidebarItems.description: Optional custom sidebar item list. Leave empty to use the app's built-in sidebar. Renamed from the legacy top-level key 'SidebarItems' — camelCase is required in this domain. ENFORCED — SidebarView renders from this list when delivered (presence/order/label/icon; ids must be route ids, unknown ids are skipped); see docs/ConfigProfileMigration.md.

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique identifier for the sidebar item.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: SF Symbol name for the sidebar item.

title.title: Title
title.description: Display title for the sidebar item.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Sign-in behavior preferences. ENFORCED in the sign-in and session views — requireBiometric, allowBiometricSetup, sessionTimeout, and allowRememberMe are all acted on by the app; see docs/ConfigProfileMigration.md.

requireBiometric.title: Require Biometric
requireBiometric.description: Require Touch ID / biometric authentication to use the app.

allowBiometricSetup.title: Allow Biometric Setup
allowBiometricSetup.description: Allow users to enable biometric unlock in-app.

sessionTimeout.title: Session Timeout (min, 0 = none)
sessionTimeout.description: Idle session timeout in minutes. 0 disables the timeout.

allowRememberMe.title: Allow Remember Me
allowRememberMe.description: Allow the sign-in screen to remember the last operator.
